title: Review of eco-lenia2 (IXDE) on fresh seed 3: replicated. Competition delays species A to 20 cells at t=278 vs 128 in the separate-food twin while B gains, A divides (12 persistent splits, generation 3), and a local food cut kills one A cell within 20 t while its fed twin and neighbours live on
summary: labkit re-runs on fresh seed 3 (160^2, t=1000): world.py (pack/) and the SEP=1 no-interaction twin (pack_sep/), species counts from labkit's per-species n_comp. Species A (MIRd+) reaches 20 cells at t=278 with competition vs t=128 in the twin (claim: 246-322 vs 120-130). It averages 14.6 vs 26.5 cells over t=100-400 (claim 14-19 vs 27-28). Species B averages 57.4 vs 50.4 cells after t=300, a small gain (claim 52.8-63.0 vs 51.1-58.1). Species A in pack/: 12 persistent splits, max generation 3, 89 merges. Local food cut (the claim's cutfork.py, species A, t_fork 400, r=12, median cell of area 143): the cut cell's core mass falls below 10% by t=420 and to 0 by t~425, while the same cell in the fed twin keeps 105%. Neighbours outside the disk persist (cutA_s3.png). The A count in the domain is 27 vs 31 at t=500.

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; I did not run the B cut or the decomposition arms. Founders are planted (no S). Matter is built only from food and decays everywhere at 0.01, so the dependence is by construction apart from the local cut, which passes. Genealogy is reticulate: A merges 89 vs 12 persistent splits by labkit.
